summary: Deltona should not keep the current standalone municipal control row. Official city, sheriff, and city annual-financial materials show that Deltona has been policed by the Volusia Sheriff's Office under contract since incorporation rather than by a Deltona Police Department, and FDLE's official county-and-municipal offense reports do not publish a separate Deltona agency row. The current all-fill state is best explained by an agency-definition / fallback-crosswalk error around pseudo-row FL0642500, not by broken continuity for a real standalone municipal police agency.
